# University of Pennsylvania Carey Law School

> Penn Carey Law is a premier legal education institution offering JD, LLM, and SJD degrees with extensive clinical programs, joint degrees, and professional development opportunities.

Penn Carey Law provides comprehensive legal education through its academic programs, clinical experience, and research initiatives. The school serves students, faculty, alumni, and practitioners through robust support systems, international engagement, and innovative legal education programs.

## Key Topics

- JD Program
- LLM Program
- SJD Program
- Clinical Programs
- Joint Degrees
- Legal Practice Skills
- Biddle Law Library
- Law Journals
- International Programs
- Executive Education
- Academic Support
- Bar Admission
- Professional Development
- Student Organizations
- Global Justice

## Academic Programs & Degrees

- [Academics](https://www.law.upenn.edu/academics): Academic programs overview including JD, LLM, and SJD degrees
- [Degree Requirements](https://www.law.upenn.edu/academics/degrees.php): Curriculum and degree requirements for JD, LLM, SJD programs
- [Joint Degrees & Certificates](https://www.law.upenn.edu/crossdisciplinary/jointdegree): Joint degree programs with Wharton, Medicine, and Social Policy
- [Legal Practice Skills](https://www.law.upenn.edu/academics/legalpracticeskills): First-year legal practice skills curriculum including writing and advocacy
- [Learning Outcomes](https://www.law.upenn.edu/academics/learning-outcomes): Program learning outcomes, curriculum standards, and professional skills
- [Academic Calendar](https://www.law.upenn.edu/academics/calendar): Academic calendar with semester schedule, exams, and graduation dates

## Student Resources & Support

- [For Students](https://www.law.upenn.edu/students): Student resources, organizations, affairs, and advocacy programs
- [Clinics & Externships](https://www.law.upenn.edu/clinic): Clinical programs including civil, criminal, and advocacy clinics
- [Biddle Law Library](https://www.law.upenn.edu/library): Biddle Law Library services, research databases, and legal research guides
- [Academic Support](https://www.law.upenn.edu/academics/support): Academic support with study techniques, exam prep, and stress management
- [Registrar](https://www.law.upenn.edu/registrar): Registrar office with academic calendar, exams, and degree requirements

## Faculty & Alumni Engagement

- [For Faculty](https://www.law.upenn.edu/facultycommons): Faculty resources, handbook, course management tools, and support
- [Alumni](https://www.law.upenn.edu/alumni): Alumni engagement hub with events, networking, and giving opportunities

## Publications & Scholarly Work

- [Journals](https://www.law.upenn.edu/journals): Law journals including Law Review, Business Law, and Asian Law Review

## Professional Development & Global Engagement

- [Legal Education Programs](https://www.law.upenn.edu/academics/legaleducationprograms): Executive education and professional development programs for practitioners
- [Executive Education](https://www.law.upenn.edu/academics/legaleducationprograms/penn-law-executive-education.php): Executive education in innovation, compliance, and regulatory analysis
- [Global Engagement](https://www.law.upenn.edu/international): International programs, study abroad, and global justice opportunities
- [Future of the Profession Initiative](https://www.law.upenn.edu/futureprofessioninitiative): Law 2030 conference and podcast exploring legal innovation and education

## Admissions & Compliance

- [ABA Compliance](https://www.law.upenn.edu/admissions/aba.php): ABA compliance data including employment, bar passage, and financial aid
